rows.grounds: compound adjective in accusative singular neuter

items.question: What must be done with the forehead syllable mass after a hundred thousand repetitions to be worshipped by gods?
items.inference: Doing a hundred thousand repetitions of the forehead syllable mass leads to being worshipped by the gods.
uncertainties: Exact ritual object and grammatical case of sura+arcite remain unclear.
items.plain_english: Having done a hundred thousand repetitions of the syllable mass situated on the forehead, one becomes worshipped by the gods.
